fields.title: 6. Unpublished Runs — Absorption Records Maintained
fields.md:
The four unpublished runs injected by the workflow (10/29 · 11/06 · 11/07 · 11/08) were already reconfirmed and absorbed from primary sources by the monthly `2026-11` (10/29) and `2026-11-09-event` (11/06–08). This run does not use the copies as sources. It rechecked in the afternoon what can be verified now — the latest EDGAR filing is still the 11/06 8-K (5.02) · Flight 15 LL2 NET 11/13 22:45 UTC (updated 11/10 22:06 UTC) unchanged · T7 ⓓ no public answer — and appended this to `state.run.unpublished_runs[].absorbed_by`. The 11/08 copy's statement 'Customer A = Google' continues not to be adopted (the 11/09 correction stands — Customer A = U.S. government) (Source: `_probe/unpublished/*.md` · `state.run.unpublished_runs`).
